incumbent_after.returning: Resume the goal on a different task using the available history.
incumbent_after.teaching: Help with the current task and then offer practice.

review.early_difference: A linked the door and cutoff to what a first-time visitor needs, then asked the writer to adapt the notice for volunteers. After the writer explained the placement, A explored when the volunteer line could help and acknowledged the revisit topic. B used the film-club landmark to prompt reflection on what the visitor could see and asked twice for approval of a specific writing goal. Both typed memories contain only the broad goal of becoming a better writer. The learner approved the topic, and the record contains no approval of B’s proposed wording.
review.evidence: At opening and feedback, A received the newcomer excerpt and a lesson about replacing assumed knowledge with facts from the brief. B received the film-club worked example and a library reservation exercise. On return, A received the two-action excerpt and lesson, which support tracing each sorting path. B received the garden worked example and choir exercise, which support distinguishing two actions. The library task appeared in A’s display and was separately supplied by the assessor. B’s display stayed with the lamp notice.
review.later_difference: A gave two library-note versions that differ by a generic introductory line and directly requested a new draft and reason. B asked for the lamp notice and suggested using the garden example to compare scanability. Both role-played attempts produced acceptable library revisions and explained why they put an identifying mark first. B’s library answer followed the assessor-supplied task, which B’s display did not give.
review.next_question: When real writers receive the same new task under comparable conditions, does carrying forward their approved purpose increase the proportion whose unaided explanations identify a specific draft choice and explain how it serves that purpose, as scored by an independent reviewer?
review.weakness: The trial shows no difference in approved typed purpose and provides no independently scored explanations from real writers. A’s direct practice prompt and B’s closer adherence to the requested lamp comparison are separate strengths. The two modeled successes cannot establish either a higher proportion or the falsifier’s no-gain result.
